units.source_text: 苗子考虑自己同被抛弃的千重子“身份悬殊”，绝不会来找千重子的。

en.t: Naeko, thinking that there was a great difference in status between herself and the abandoned Chieko, would certainly never come looking for Chieko.

units.source_text: 只能由千重子到她工作的地方去找她。

en.t: Chieko would have to go to the place where Naeko worked and look for her there.
